traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria and listed requirements for Story 006.0-DEV-FILE-VALIDATION are fully implemented and verified.
Core functionality is provided by the valid-story-reference ESLint rule, which parses @story annotations, resolves their paths using context.cwd/process.cwd, and validates that referenced files exist, have the expected .story.md extension by default, and reside within the project boundary. It supports configurable storyDirectories, allowAbsolutePaths, and requireStoryExtension options.
Tests in tests/rules/valid-story-reference.test.ts are explicitly traced to docs/stories/006.0-DEV-FILE-VALIDATION.story.md via @story and @supports annotations and thoroughly exercise: - happy-path existence and extension validation, - relative and absolute path resolution, - configuration behaviors for storyDirectories, allowAbsolutePaths, and requireStoryExtension, - project-boundary and path-security constraints (path traversal, external directories), and - robust error handling for filesystem failures, including permission and I/O errors, with clear, specific diagnostics (fileMissing, invalidExtension, invalidPath, fileAccessError).
The implementation uses a caching layer for file-existence checks, respects project boundaries, and fails safely on filesystem errors, matching Quality, Error Handling, Security, Performance, and Integration criteria. Dedicated rule documentation exists and matches the behavior and configuration described in the story. With the targeted and global Jest runs passing, there is concrete evidence that the story is fully implemented and functioning as specified.
